next_question: On a substrate where the cost of re-deriving a task is NOT fixed by construction and can be manipulated INDEPENDENTLY of the cost of executing an inherited mechanism -- so that the two are separated by a ratio the experiment sets, rather than being pinned equal or near-equal by the presence or absence of auth and pagination -- is the break-even reuse count at which CROSS-EPISODE inherited execution becomes cheaper than WITHIN-EPISODE reuse of the same discovered knowledge (a scratchpad arm and a retrieval-K5 arm, not merely cold re-derivation) a monotone function of that re-derivation-to-inherited-execution cost ratio, and does that break-even fall below a reuse count any product can actually reach; with the regime boundary located by the cost RATIO rather than by the auth/pagination dichotomy, F4 restated before freeze to handle an infinite break-even explicitly, every comparator required to reach a non-degenerate task success rate so that 'matched end-to-end success' has a referent, and a mandatory probe arm that binds a WELL-FORMED identifier for a resource never observed in training -- for example collection='products' on a mechanism trained only on 'items' -- so that the slot-value guard's SEMANTIC false-accept rate is measured rather than its punctuation rejection?
why_next: This packet executed its frozen design cleanly and still left the product decision unmade, and the reason is structural rather than a matter of running it again harder. Three things it measured are real: the committed kernel now reaches EXECUTABLE from observation, the induced mechanism transfers to a disjoint identifier namespace at 1.0000 task success in both regimes, and the min_confidence gate is demonstrably load-bearing. Three things it did not measure are the things the product decision needs. First, the economic comparison that decides the architecture was lost, not won: against executed cold re-derivation inheritance is 2.98x cheaper per task, but B-RETRIEVAL-K5-COSTLY is per-task IDENTICAL to inheritance while charging no induction cost, and B-SCRATCHPAD-COSTLY is cheaper on total cost, so at the executed n = 150 cross-episode inheritance does not beat the reuse baseline a product would actually ship. Second, the half of the design that was supposed to discriminate regimes produced no discriminating data at all: all six cheap arms are pointwise identical at 1.0000 requests per task and 1.0000 success, which makes the amortized ratio 1 + 150/n, which is unsatisfiable against the frozen 0.85 threshold for every n > 0, so f*_cheap = infinity is an algebraic identity and not an empirical negative about Web APIs. Third, the mechanism result rests on a slot the kernel declares rather than one it observes, so the parent's open question is untouched. A fourth, unplanned finding reorders the priority: the safety gate that was declared mandatory and load-bearing measured only that a regex rejects empty strings and punctuation. Every one of the 60 probes bound collection='products', a collection appearing in zero training observations, and the guard's own source comment says it accepts 'products'. So the one liability the architecture most needs bounded -- does an inherited mechanism silently act on a resource it never saw -- is untested. The next question therefore changes the level of description twice over: from a surface dichotomy (auth and pagination present or absent, which forced the degenerate comparison) to a manipulable cost ratio (re-derivation cost divided by inherited-execution cost, set by the experiment rather than inherited from the substrate's shape), and from a syntactic safety probe to a semantic one that binds a well-formed identifier for a never-observed resource. It also names the comparator that actually decides the architecture, within-episode reuse, which the frozen economics gate of this packet omitted from its primary criterion even though the mandate required it as a named arm. Re-running this design, restating F4 alone, or adding a third regime that repeats the auth/pagination contrast would each return a third non-decision; the missing ingredients are the cost ratio as a free variable, a comparator that can win, and a probe that can actually fail.

established: Measurement validity: this was a valid measurement transaction and NOT an infrastructure failure and NOT a falsification. Both preregistered regimes satisfied their surface contract before the arms ran (raw_evidence/substrate_probe.json: costly exposes /auth/login with a token, /schema with verbs, pagination, and 401 after token expiry at 100 requests; cheap serves a direct GET with no auth and a 404 on /schema), so falsifiers F6 and F7 do not trigger and the OUTCOME was decidable rather than INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_APPLICABLE. Cost accounting used counted HTTP requests from the substrate's own responses under one declared tiktoken cl100k_base basis, with no imported per-observation constants, no jitter and no f-scaled substitution, so F8 does not trigger (audit.validity_findings[0] and [5]; provenance.json.environment.tokenizer_declared). Total 1689 counted requests: 150 induction, 888 costly regime, 651 cheap regime, with 16 re-authentications charged in the costly regime at seed 42 and family-stratified B=5000 bootstrap over 3 strata. No protocol amendment was made (provenance.json.validity.protocol_amendments is empty).

Durability precondition F5 is met, and the code exists at commit: kernel.distill_parameterized was committed with a nonempty diff of 3 files and 564 insertions against base_sha 4682030b49d96a0dc1c4a7522ed767ac0efcc3d6, kernel sha256 57690132de402c12c866a16f0e1dd2901c036dcb852813958895d7a01d340de3, and provenance.json.test_evidence records 9 passed with 9 tests reaching EXECUTABLE through distill_parameterized rather than by hand-building a Mechanism at a fixed confidence. Director-verified at verdict time as an artifact-identity check, not a measurement: HEAD 0411427ea07e85e8d8d5189698eb6734f92dc58e carries the same kernel digest, 'git status --porcelain -- src tests' is empty, and the base-to-HEAD diff for src, tests, sdk and pyproject.toml is exactly src/spider/kernel.py, src/spider/models.py and tests/test_kernel.py. This establishes that the committed induction path EXISTS; it does not establish that it will survive this verdict, and per verdict.product_action it will not.

Bounded mechanism result, the strongest positive in this packet: a mechanism induced from 150 observations of resource A (items) over 50 distinct identifiers item-151..item-200 across 3 families (read, update, delete) transfers to never-observed resource-B identifiers (products) with a disjoint namespace at task success 1.0000, 150/150, in BOTH regimes, and the confidence is derived rather than hardcoded at 1.0 against a min_confidence of 0.8 (raw_evidence/mechanisms.json). PC-SAME-RESOURCE independently reached 1.0000 on 150 held-out resource-A identifiers through the same distill_parameterized path, so the induction pipeline is demonstrated to work before transfer rather than after it.

Bounded economics result in the costly regime, exact and reproducible from recorded means: B-COLD-COSTLY 3.06 requests per task with CI95 [3.013333333333333, 3.12] against INHERITANCE-COSTLY 1.0266666666666666 with CI95 [1.0, 1.0666666666666667], an amortized cost ratio of 0.6623093681917211 at n=150 falling to 0.85 at n=96, and break-even f*_costly = 74. Director arithmetic on the producer's own recorded numbers reproduces all three exactly: f* = ceil(150 / (3.06 - 77/75)) = ceil(73.77) = 74, and 150 + (77/75)n = 0.85 * 3.06 * n gives n = 95.28 and therefore 96. Inheritance also beats B-NO-MEMORY-COSTLY and B-INSTRUCTIONS-COSTLY, both 2.04.

The min_confidence gate is load-bearing and its removal is not survivable, which is the load-bearing safety datum: NC-SHUFFLED-INTENT induced confidences of 0.38, 0.40 and 0.44 against the 0.8 execution threshold abstained on 150/150 tasks in BOTH regimes at 0.0000 requests and 0.0000 task success. A mechanism that removes work while silently replaying a wrong action is therefore blocked by this kernel, and the block is exercised rather than assumed.

The syntactic slot-value guard rejects malformed bindings: 60 negative probes, 20 each of invalid_intent, out_of_support_binding and empty_string_binding, all recorded with executed=false and status=UNKNOWN (raw_evidence/probe_results.jsonl), giving abstention_precision 1.0 and false_accept_rate 0.0 on the probes that were run. This is established for the syntactic dimension ONLY -- see do_not_assume, which states precisely what it does not cover.

The cost model of this experiment is now fully written down and reusable as a specification, including the fact that it is degenerate in one half: the amortized ratio is (induction_cost + n * transfer_cost) / (n * cold_cost). With this packet's parameters it is (150 + n) / (3.06n) in the costly regime and (150 + n) / (1.0n) = 1 + 150/n in the cheap regime. A future agent can therefore compute f* for any (induction, cold, transfer) triple without re-running anything.

Control-plane facts verified by the Director at verdict time, which are artifact-identity facts about the repository and create no scientific data: scripts/freeze_experiment.py binds exactly three document hashes (request.json, spec.json, prereg.md) and can never bind code, so a prereg requirement of committed code at freeze is unsatisfiable in every lane and durability must be attested at EXECUTE by commit sha256 plus a nonempty diff; and on a falsy promote_to_product, .github/workflows/spider-lane.yml line 324 runs scripts/revert_product_reject.py, which restores every changed product allowed_code_roots path to execution_checkpoint.json pre_execute_sha 54fbb9951b38c96509e2fbf2ff65a7d82ec0315c, deleting the committed induction capability. research/lanes/product/state.json carries promotion_ready false, so product-promote.yml exits 0 before reaching any audit or verdict check. This is the sixteenth add-at-execute/delete-at-verdict cycle and it is a structural prediction, not a surprise.
rejected: Bounded to this run: reading F4's trigger as falsifying regime-dependent persistence. F4 as frozen reads 'f*_costly / f*_cheap <= 2.0'; with f*_cheap = infinity the ratio evaluates to 0 and triggers. The direction of the underlying difference is the MAXIMAL possible regime difference (finite 74 versus structurally unreachable infinity), so the trigger is an artifact of the infinity convention. Rejected as a falsification because a convention artifact is not a measurement. Equally NOT accepted as a confirmation, because the cheap regime supplied no data at all -- see the next entry.

Bounded to this run: treating f*_cheap = infinity, and F3's cheap-regime trigger, as an empirical negative about cheap-re-derivation regimes. Under the frozen cost model the amortized ratio in the cheap regime is 1 + 150/n, which is >= 1 for every n > 0, so the frozen threshold of <= 0.85 is UNSATISFIABLE BY CONSTRUCTION and n_for_ratio_0.85_cheap is correctly null. The measured 2.0 at n=150 confirms only that the implementation matches the declared cost model. Independently, all six cheap arms (B-COLD-CHEAP, B-SCRATCHPAD-CHEAP, B-NO-MEMORY-CHEAP, B-INSTRUCTIONS-CHEAP, B-RETRIEVAL-K5-CHEAP, INHERITANCE-CHEAP) are pointwise identical at 1.0000 requests per task and 1.0000 success at n=150, so the cheap half of this experiment contains zero discriminating data. This rejects the cheap-regime arm AS AN INSTRUMENT, not the hypothesis that persistence is useless where re-derivation is cheap.

Bounded to this run: reading amortized_cost_ratio_vs_bcold_costly 0.6623 as evidence that persistent inheritance pays for itself. It pays relative to EXECUTED COLD RE-DERIVATION ONLY. At the executed n=150 it loses to B-SCRATCHPAD-COSTLY on total cost (the scratchpad pays 3.06 once and 1.0666666666666667 thereafter, with no induction) and it TIES B-RETRIEVAL-K5-COSTLY per task at an identical 1.0266666666666666 while paying 150 extra induction requests. Director arithmetic on the recorded means, offered as recomputation and not as a new measurement: equating 150 + (77/75)n against 3.06 + (16/15)(n-1) gives 0.04n = 148.0066667 and n = 3700.2; report.md section 8 item 4 and audit.unresolved[2] both cite approximately 3750 tasks, a figure that appears in no raw artifact and whose derivation is unrecorded; and against B-RETRIEVAL-K5, where the per-task means are identical, the cross-episode break-even is unbounded. In every reading the number is far outside the executed n=150.

Bounded to this run: result.json.observations[2] -- 'The collection slot is induced from the observation state field matching the path segment, not hand-declared' -- is rejected as an interpretation contradicted by the packet's own raw evidence. raw_evidence/mechanisms.json failure_boundary records declared_identity_slots ['collection'], inferred_slots ['id'] and excluded_identifier_keys ['collection']; run_experiment.py:562 calls kernel.distill_parameterized with no identity_fields argument, so the hardcoded DEFAULT_IDENTITY_FIELDS = ('collection','resource') at src/spider/kernel.py:75 applies; and raw_evidence/observations.jsonl shows 150 of 150 training observations at path prefix '/items/' with state.collection == 'items'. The record of the statement stands in result.json; the inference it licenses is rejected. Consequence: the 1.0000 transfer to 'products' is evidence that the declared-identity-field heuristic is PERMISSIVE, not that variability was learned.

Bounded to this run: abstention_precision 1.0 and false_accept_rate 0.0 as evidence that the kernel is safe against inherited mechanisms acting on the wrong resource. run_experiment.py:519-526 shows every one of the 60 probes binds collection='products' -- a collection that appears in ZERO training observations -- and every rejection is attributable to an empty id, an id with '!!unsupported!!' appended rejected by _SLOT_VALUE at src/spider/kernel.py:20, or the unseen intent string 'read-widget'. src/spider/kernel.py:17-19 documents that the guard accepts 'items' and 'products'. The semantic false-accept rate is UNMEASURED, not zero. This does not contradict the parent's finding of a 0.5 false-accept rate on out-of-support bindings; it shows that the new guard narrows the syntactic case only and leaves the semantic case untouched.

Bounded to this run: the frozen gate as a source of a clean SUPPORTS or FALSIFIES. spec.json.decision_rule.outcome_mapping assigns FALSIFIES to 'Any falsifier F1-F8 triggers' while the MIXED clause covers 'economics fails in one regime OR f* ratio inconclusive', and F3 and F4 are precisely the economics and ratio falsifiers, so the two clauses collide (audit.required_fixes[1]). MIXED is adopted as the least-wrong reading, and no claim consequence is read off the outcome. Do not re-freeze F4 in its current form.

Bounded to this run: the success metric as evidence of anything. All 15 arms record arm_success_rate 1.0000 and arm_http_ok_rate 1.0000 at n=150 (derived.json), so 'matched end-to-end success' is trivially satisfied by every arm including the no-op-style comparators, no arm demonstrated error resistance on any surface, and the family-stratified bootstrap intervals on success are degenerate at [1.0, 1.0] by ceiling effect. Request-count intervals are the only informative ones in this packet.

Bounded to this run: the transfer result as evidence about real Web APIs, real sites, browser interaction, cross-site transfer, semantic or model-based resolution, model tokens, latency, or any surface whose URL shape differs from /{collection}/{id}. The substrate is a self-authored in-process stdlib HTTP server; all three task families differ by VERB and intent namespace only and share one path form. Nothing here transfers to the real Web by itself.

Explicitly NOT rejected, and not closed by this packet: parameterized inheritance as SPIDER's central mechanism; the claims C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-PRODUCT-ECON, C-LLM-INHERIT, C-CROSSSITE, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, C-FRESHNESS, C-DELTA-REPAIR, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY and C-MEAS-VALID; the accumulating architecture; and the Product lane. This packet establishes a bounded positive, a bounded instrument defect and a bounded loss against the strongest comparator, and it closes nothing. A bounded negative in one frozen cost model is not a bounded negative about a domain.
unknown: The semantic false-accept rate of the committed kernel: whether an inherited mechanism will silently execute against a resource, verb or path shape it never observed, when the binding is WELL FORMED. The syntactic guard's acceptance set is documented in the source and includes the unobserved collection, and no probe in this packet tested it. This is the highest-priority unknown because it bounds the architectural liability directly.

Whether cross-episode inherited execution ever beats within-episode reuse at a reuse count a product can actually reach. This packet measured the loss at n=150 and computed a break-even of roughly 3700 tasks against the scratchpad on the recorded means, with no derivation recorded in any raw artifact, and an unbounded break-even against B-RETRIEVAL-K5 because the per-task means are identical. Whether either figure survives a realistic per-task re-derivation cost is untested.

The true shape of the regime boundary. This packet's only regime contrast was the auth/pagination dichotomy, which forced the cheap-regime ratio to exactly 1 and made that half degenerate. The quantity that actually governs amortization is the ratio of per-task re-derivation cost to inherited-execution cost, and no experiment has yet manipulated that ratio as a free variable or shown that the break-even is monotone in it.

Whether a per-task re-derivation cost of 1 request is representative of the credential-free read-only class SPIDER actually reached. C-CROSSSITE remains at HYPOTHESIS and its real-Web surface measurement is itself a null-valued primary metric, so the cheap regime here is a constructed regime, not an observed one.

Whether the parent handoff's open question -- can variability be LEARNED rather than DECLARED, from two structurally different resources, and then applied to a third of neither shape -- is answerable at all with the current kernel. The kernel declares variable any path segment whose value appears in a fixed identity-field vocabulary; whether that heuristic can ever be replaced by an observation of variability across collections is untested, and this packet's single-collection training set is exactly the distribution under which the heuristic and genuine learning are indistinguishable.

Durability of the committed induction capability past this verdict. It is committed and hash-verified at verdict time, but promote_to_product is false, so revert_product_reject.py is predicted to restore src/spider/kernel.py, src/spider/models.py and tests/test_kernel.py to 54fbb9951b38c96509e2fbf2ff65a7d82ec0315c, returning HEAD to the kernel whose distill() hard-codes confidence 0.5 against resolve()'s min_confidence 0.8. Whether any sanctioned path exists for product code to survive a non-promoting verdict is unresolved and is a control-plane question above this lane.

C-LLM-INHERIT and every real-agent economics term. model_calls 0, model_tokens 0, api_key_present false, browser_available false, embedding_service unavailable; retrieval, verification, repair, staleness and maintenance costs are all UNKNOWN with stated reasons and were not proxied. The smallest unblocking action is an OPENAI_API_KEY or any model or embedding service, then the same dual-regime design under a real agent.

Whether a well-formed binding can be made to fail safely without collapsing the transfer rate. The liability is now characterized in two parts -- malformed bindings are rejected, well-formed unobserved-resource bindings are untested -- and the remedy is not.

Whether the correct decision-rule form for a break-even quantity is a ratio at a chosen reuse count or a comparison of break-evens across comparators. This packet froze the former as the primary metric and the mandate named within-episode reuse as a required comparator, and the two do not meet; the next freeze has to decide which instrument the architecture decision is actually made with.

Whether the program-level control-plane defects can be repaired without weakening preregistration discipline: a build stage between prereg and freeze (or kernel fixes moved into execute and preregistered as a measurement), a substrate surface-contract test in the freeze gate so a correct hash cannot certify a wrong design, and a sanctioned persistence path for product code that does not depend on passing a gate. All three are workflow items and none is answerable from inside this packet.
do_not_assume: Do not assume C-PRODUCT-ECON advanced. It is HELD AT HYPOTHESIS, its registry status. audit.json.claim_ceiling proposed EXPERIMENTAL and the producer requested it; this Director bounded narrower, which the packet contract permits. Three of the four cost terms in the claim's own title -- retrieval, verification, maintenance -- were never measured in any arm, the registry next_gate is 'end-to-end amortized economics on real agents' and there is no agent in this packet, and the one measured term shows a gain only against cold re-derivation and a loss against within-episode reuse. Do not read the measured sub-result as a ceiling change.

Do not assume C-PARAM-INHERIT is validated, promoted or advanced. It is RETAINED at EXPERIMENTAL, which is also the registry ceiling (research/claims/registry.json line 6). audit.json status is REVISE, not PASS, and producer_claim_supported is false, so the audit's PASS-like language attests only that the transaction was auditable with every metric independently recomputed. VALIDATED requires a PASS audit and is not available here.

Do not assume the collection slot was learned. It was DECLARED. mechanisms.json records declared_identity_slots ['collection']; the mechanism is the hardcoded DEFAULT_IDENTITY_FIELDS = ('collection','resource') at src/spider/kernel.py:75 applied by default; and all 150 training observations are in the single collection 'items'. Any plan that relies on this kernel having OBSERVED that the collection segment varies is unsupported, and the parent handoff's variability-learning question is still open.

Do not assume the safety gate establishes that the kernel is safe against the wrong resource. 0 of 60 probes executed and false_accept_rate is 0.0, but every probe bound collection='products', a collection absent from training, and every rejection came from an empty id, a punctuated id, or an unseen intent string. src/spider/kernel.py:17-19 states the guard accepts 'products'. The semantic false-accept rate is unmeasured. Also note that raw_evidence/probe_results.jsonl records no binding values at all (keys: arm, executed, intent, kind, probe_index, status), so the null arm's discriminating power cannot be reconstructed from raw evidence.

Do not cite 0.6623 or f* = 74 as a product-economics result or as a break-even for the architecture. They are one amortized ratio and one break-even against EXECUTED COLD RE-DERIVATION ONLY, on a self-authored stdlib substrate, with a cost basis of counted HTTP requests, a deterministic executor, 0 model tokens, no browser, no verification, no maintenance and a single episode. The same run lost to B-SCRATCHPAD-COSTLY and tied B-RETRIEVAL-K5-COSTLY per task while paying 150 extra requests. The value 74 is fully determined by three substrate parameters this experiment itself produced (induction 150, cold 3.06, transfer 1.0266666666666666) and does not transfer to a real API.

Do not cite f*_cheap = infinity, the amortized ratio 2.0, or F3's and F4's triggers as evidence that persistence is useless where re-derivation is cheap. Under the frozen cost model the cheap-regime ratio is 1 + 150/n, unsatisfiable against 0.85 for every n > 0, and all six cheap arms are pointwise identical at 1.0000 requests and 1.0000 success. This is a design identity, and it is rejected as an instrument in both directions: it does not support unconditional persistence either.

Do not adopt a per-object persistence policy, in either direction, on this packet. The decision needs the cheap-regime input and that input is analytically forced. 'Re-derivation plus caching with a persistence policy' is a hypothesis this packet raised, not a finding it established.

Do not quote the approximately 3750-task scratchpad break-even as a recorded measurement. It appears in report.md and in audit.unresolved[2] but in no raw artifact and with no derivation. Director arithmetic on the recorded means gives 0.04n = 148.0066667 and n = 3700.2, and against B-RETRIEVAL-K5, whose per-task mean is identical to inheritance, the break-even is unbounded. Cite the expression, not the rounded figure.

Do not treat any arm's 1.0000 task success as evidence of robustness. All 15 arms scored 1.0000 success and 1.0000 HTTP-ok at n=150 on a deterministic substrate, so the success metric had zero discriminative power here, no arm was made to fail, and the bootstrap intervals on success are degenerate at [1.0, 1.0] by ceiling effect. Request-count intervals are the only informative ones.

Do not treat the Director's repository verifications as new outcome-bearing measurements. The HEAD, sha256, git status and diff-stat checks cited in established are artifact-identity facts about the current repository state. They create no scientific data, they cannot substitute for a durability test, and the committed kernel is scheduled for deletion by this verdict regardless.

Do not re-run this design, and do not treat a restated F4 as the fix. Correcting F4 alone returns a third non-decision, because the cheap regime stays analytically degenerate and the primary economics criterion stays pointed at B-COLD rather than at within-episode reuse. The three binding missing ingredients are a manipulable re-derivation-to-execution cost ratio, a comparator that can win, and a probe that can actually fail.

Do not assume the next experiment is authorized. This was a completed, committed transaction, not a resumption. The six lanes do not self-authorize child experiments; Scout and the Global Research Director reconsider the whole program first, and a NEW experiment is allocated only with a director_mandate. This handoff's next_question is a proposal to accept, redirect or reject, and continue is false for exactly that reason.

Do not treat the Product lane as terminated, and do not treat the inheritance or product-viability domains as closed. The architecture decision is genuinely unmade, the mechanism half transferred cleanly, the safety half is untested where it matters, and the economics half is measured only against the weakest comparator. C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-PRODUCT-ECON, C-LLM-INHERIT and C-CROSSSITE all remain exactly where the program needs them.

dependencies: A Global Research Director mandate for a NEW product packet. This transaction completed and was adjudicated; the next question is not a resumption of a committed scientific transaction, so the lane cannot self-authorize it and continue is false. The frozen decision rule also has to be re-designed and re-frozen, which is itself a new experiment.

F4 restated before any re-freeze so that an infinite break-even is an explicit case rather than an arithmetic accident. The current clause 'f*_costly / f*_cheap <= 2.0' evaluates 74 / infinity as 0 and triggers, which is a convention artifact. Restate it as a one-sided test or with explicit infinity handling, AND resolve the FALSIFIES-versus-MIXED collision in decision_rule.outcome_mapping, where 'Any falsifier F1-F8 triggers' contradicts 'economics fails in one regime OR f* ratio inconclusive' (audit.required_fixes[0] and [1]). Splitting the gate into an independently decidable mechanism condition and an independently decidable economics condition, as the parent handoff already recommended, remains the correct structural fix.

A substrate whose per-task re-derivation cost is a FREE VARIABLE, not a property of the surface. This is the single ingredient the next question needs and this packet lacks: with the cheap regime pinned at 1 request per task, the amortized ratio becomes 1 + induction/n and the frozen threshold is unsatisfiable by construction. The substrate must be able to present the same resource at several measured re-derivation costs so the ratio of re-derivation cost to inherited-execution cost can be set by the experiment.

A mandatory primary criterion against WITHIN-EPISODE reuse, not only against cold re-derivation. request.json.director_mandate named the scratchpad, no-memory, instructions and retrieval-K5 arms as required comparators, but spec.json.decision_rule made the 0.85 ratio against B-COLD the only economics criterion, and that omission is what let the packet report a ratio of 0.6623 while losing the comparison that decides the architecture. Any next economics gate must name the within-episode comparator in the frozen decision rule, not only in the baseline list.

Comparators that can WIN, or at least can fail: all 15 arms in this packet scored 1.0000 task success, so 'matched end-to-end success' had no referent. The next design needs at least one comparator with a non-degenerate success rate, and needs the substrate to be able to make some arm fail, so the success metric regains discriminative power.

A semantic slot-value guard, or at minimum a probe that can fail. The mandatory safety gate passed only in its syntactic dimension. The smallest unblocking step is a probe family that binds a WELL-FORMED identifier for a resource never observed in training -- collection='products' on a mechanism trained only on 'items' -- and records the binding value in the raw log, which raw_evidence/probe_results.jsonl currently does not.

A restated, corrected producer observation before this packet's mechanism result is reused. result.json.observations[2] asserts the collection slot is not hand-declared and raw_evidence/mechanisms.json contradicts it. The contradiction is recorded here and in the verdict; the raw artifact governs, and no downstream agent should cite observations[2] without this qualification.

A sanctioned persistence path for product code that does not depend on passing a gate. This is the largest structural blocker and it is a control-plane decision, not a lane decision: on any falsy promote_to_product, .github/workflows/spider-lane.yml line 324 runs scripts/revert_product_reject.py and restores src/spider/kernel.py, src/spider/models.py and tests/test_kernel.py to 54fbb9951b38c96509e2fbf2ff65a7d82ec0315c, while research/lanes/product/state.json carries promotion_ready false so product-promote.yml exits before reaching any check. Until this is resolved, every product capability is deleted by construction. The lane must not edit the control plane.

A control-plane repair for build-before-freeze, either a sanctioned build stage between prereg and freeze or kernel fixes moved into execute and preregistered as a measurement rather than a precondition. scripts/freeze_experiment.py binds exactly request.json, spec.json and prereg.md and can never bind code, so no preregistration requiring committed code at freeze can be satisfied in any lane. This packet satisfied its durability precondition by committing during EXECUTE and attesting at EXECUTE by commit sha256 and a nonempty diff, which works but is a workaround, not a fix.

A substrate surface-contract test in the freeze gate, carried forward unchanged from the parent handoff and still unmet. It remains true that a freeze gate binding document hashes can certify a design that does not match its declared surface. This packet's substrate happened to satisfy its contract and was verified by a pre-arm probe, but the freeze gate itself performed no design audit.

Unchanged and still absent, so C-LLM-INHERIT and all real-agent economics stay deferred: OPENAI_API_KEY or any model or embedding service, a browser or browsergym image, a permitted docker pull, and any real agent under a real budget. provenance.json.environment records model_calls 0, model_tokens 0, api_key_present false and embedding_service unavailable. The smallest unblocking action is a model credential; the same dual-regime design under a real agent is the named next measurement by both the producer and the auditor.

Optionally, but at low cost, the credential-free real-Web substrate already established by EXP-FRONTIER-36293269574 (five public eTLD+1 hosts, 50 episodes, 100 HTTP GETs per executable arm, stdlib only). It is the cheapest available route to a non-degenerate real-surface measurement of the cheap-re-derivation regime, which is currently constructed rather than observed.
